annotations.title: Get your service submitted to the agent venues we can reach, and to each new one as we add it (paid, x402)

description: PAID: list your service on agent venues: we submit it to each venue we have a submitter for (32 of 96 today) and prove each entry landed, weekly for 90 days. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.2500 USDC.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

id.description: The order id, as returned when it was paid for.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of YOUR service -- the one a venue should list. It must be publicly reachable: a loopback or private address is one no venue can verify.
